Definition: from the same as G778; a leathern (or skin) bag used as a bottle:--bottle.
BiblicalUsage: A bottle in the ancient world was a skin bag, and Jesus used it for one of His plainest pictures. New wine bursts old skins, so it must go into new ones, and the point was that His teaching could not be poured into the old forms without breaking them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus was telling His hearers that the new covenant is not a patch on the old one, it is something fresh that needs room to grow. Trying to hold it in the old skins only spills the wine and ruins the skins.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
